comments.body:
Sold for 150 ducats a piece in Item Shops throughout the following cities:

Northern Europe: Amsterdam, Oxford, London
Western Europe: Seville, Paris, Florence, Marseille, Lisbon
Eastern Europe: Venice
Atlantis: Acropolis (though only when present in the server)
